name: UI/UX & HCI
description: Designing usable products: human factors, user research, interaction and visual design, and usability testing.

nodes.name: HCI foundations
nodes.desc: Human-computer interaction as a field and user-centred design.
nodes.summary: You will understand human-computer interaction as a field and the principles of user-centred design.

nodes.name: Perception & cognition
nodes.desc: Gestalt principles, attention, memory limits, Fitts's law and Hick's law.
nodes.summary: You will be able to apply Gestalt principles, attention and memory limits, and Fitts's and Hick's laws to interface design.

nodes.name: Design process
nodes.desc: Discover, define, develop and deliver as an iterative process.
nodes.summary: You will be able to run an iterative design process through discover, define, develop and deliver phases.

nodes.name: Usability heuristics
nodes.desc: Nielsen's heuristics and common usability problems.
nodes.summary: You will be able to evaluate an interface against Nielsen's heuristics and report common usability problems.

nodes.name: User research
nodes.desc: Interviews, contextual inquiry and observing real users.
nodes.summary: You will be able to plan and conduct interviews, contextual inquiry and observation to understand real users.

nodes.name: Personas & journeys
nodes.desc: Synthesising research into personas, journey maps and problem statements.
nodes.summary: You will be able to synthesise research into personas, journey maps and clear problem statements.

nodes.name: Surveys & analytics
nodes.desc: Writing unbiased surveys and reading product analytics.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write unbiased surveys and interpret product analytics such as funnels and retention.

nodes.name: Info architecture
nodes.desc: Card sorting, navigation structures and content hierarchy.
nodes.summary: You will be able to organise content and navigation using card sorting, tree testing and clear hierarchies.

nodes.name: Wireframes
nodes.desc: Sketching and wireframing layouts and flows.
nodes.summary: You will be able to sketch and wireframe screen layouts and user flows quickly at low fidelity.

nodes.name: Interaction patterns
nodes.desc: Common patterns for navigation, input, search and feedback.
nodes.summary: You will be able to apply common interaction patterns for navigation, input, search and feedback consistently.

nodes.name: Prototyping
nodes.desc: Clickable prototypes at the right fidelity for the question.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build clickable prototypes at the right fidelity for the design question you need to answer.

nodes.name: Forms & feedback
nodes.desc: Form design, validation, empty, loading and error states and microcopy.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design usable forms with helpful validation and clear empty, loading and error states.

nodes.name: App redesign
nodes.desc: Research and redesign a flow in an existing app as a tested prototype.
nodes.summary: You will research and redesign a flow in an existing app and validate it as a tested prototype.

nodes.name: Typography
nodes.desc: Typefaces, type scales, line length and readability.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose typefaces and build type scales that make interfaces readable and well structured.

nodes.name: Colour & contrast
nodes.desc: Colour palettes, meaning, contrast ratios and dark mode.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build colour palettes with meaning, meet contrast requirements and adapt designs to dark mode.

nodes.name: Layout & grids
nodes.desc: Grids, spacing systems, alignment and visual hierarchy.
nodes.summary: You will be able to lay out screens with grids, spacing systems and alignment to create clear visual hierarchy.

nodes.name: Design systems
nodes.desc: Design tokens, component libraries and documentation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build and document a design system with tokens and reusable components.

nodes.name: Accessible design
nodes.desc: Designing for screen readers, keyboard use and low vision.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design interfaces that work with screen readers, keyboards and low vision following WCAG guidance.

nodes.name: Usability testing
nodes.desc: Planning, moderating and analysing usability tests.
nodes.summary: You will be able to plan, moderate and analyse usability tests and turn findings into design changes.
topics: Measuring success and time on task

nodes.name: A/B testing
nodes.desc: Running controlled experiments on design changes.
nodes.summary: You will be able to run controlled A/B experiments on design changes and interpret results correctly.

nodes.name: Design to code
nodes.desc: Handing off designs and working with engineers on implementation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to hand off designs clearly and collaborate with engineers to implement them faithfully.

nodes.name: UX case study
nodes.desc: Take a product problem from research to a tested, accessible design and document it.
nodes.summary: You will take a product problem from research to a tested, accessible design and document the process as a case study.
